assumptions: FY2027 is NVIDIA's disclosed 53-week fiscal year. Reported GAAP diluted EPS is $4.85 for the first 26 weeks ended 2026-07-26, using the reported diluted-share basis; grid assumes a constant split-adjusted share basis solely for sensitivity. Annual EPS cases are analyst assumptions, not consensus: bear $8.50 (remaining 27-week EPS $3.65, reflecting demand/order normalization and/or margin pressure); base $9.50 (remaining $4.65, supported by Q3 revenue guidance of $108bn +/-2%, but no Q4 guidance); bull $10.50 (remaining $5.65, requiring continued data-center demand and execution beyond the disclosed Q3 outlook). Multiples 18x/24x/30x are hypothetical stress inputs, not observed, fair, normal, or probable multiples.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
